canonical_name: Grothendieck theorem: nuclear spaces have the approximation property
canonical_statement: Every nuclear locally convex topological vector space over the real or complex scalars has the approximation property: its identity is in the closure, for uniform convergence on compact subsets, of its finite-rank continuous linear endomorphisms.

conclusion: The identity of E is a compact-convergence limit of finite-rank continuous linear endomorphisms.
